# RunbookPilot

> Safety-gated AI SRE incident response & runbook automation console built with Qwen and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- Live Demo: https://yuzhang-zhong.github.io/runbookpilot/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/yuzhang-zhong/runbookpilot

## Capabilities
- Bounded read-only MCP incident investigation (`query_metrics`, `search_logs`, `inspect_deployment`, `check_dependencies`).
- Log prompt-injection defense that separates untrusted telemetry from deterministic remediation policy.
- HMAC-SHA-256 human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints before allowlisted sandbox mutations (`rollback_release`, `restart_canary`).
- Post-remediation `verify_health` checks across 8 repeatable incident scenarios.
